chapter.heading: Psalm 123
Our Eyes Look to the LORD Our God
A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
To you
I lift,
up my eyes, O you who are enthroned in the heavens!

Behold, as
the eyes,
of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he has mercy upon us.

Have mercy
upon us,,
O LORD, have mercy upon us, for we have had more than enough of contempt.

Our soul
has had,
more than enough of the scorn of those who are at ease, of the contempt of the proud. (ESV)
